question: The first World Deaf T20 Cricket Championship will be organised by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first World Deaf T20 Cricket Championship will be organized by India.**
 
• The tournament is likely to be held in **November 2022.**
 
• The tournament will be organized by the** All India Cricket Association for the Deaf (AICAD).**
 
• A minimum of eight countries are expected to take part in the championship.
 
• The tournament will feature eight teams from different parts of the world, including Australia, England, South Africa, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Nepal, and hosts India.
 
• AISCD is the only Centre-recognised national sports federation for the deaf.
 
• The ICSD is the only international federation recognized as the governing body of the deaf sports movement and Deaflympics sanctioned by the International Olympic Committee.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **West Indies: **The West Indies cricket team represents a collection of 15 Caribbean territories and dependencies, including Jamaica, Trinidad and Tobago, and Barbados.

 
 
• The West Indies team has won two ICC Cricket World Cup titles and two ICC World Twenty20 titles.
 
 
 
• **Australia: **The Australian cricket team, also known as the Baggy Greens, is the most successful team in the history of Test cricket, with the most wins and the highest winning percentage.
 
 
• The Australian team has also won five ICC Cricket World Cup titles and one ICC World Twenty20 title.
 
 
 
• **England**: The England cricket team is the birthplace of cricket and is one of the oldest teams in international cricket. England has won one ICC Cricket World Cup title and one ICC World Twenty20 title.
 
• **India: **The Indian cricket team is the current ICC World Test Championship runner-up and has won two ICC Cricket World Cup titles and one ICC World Twenty20 title.
 
 
• India is also the host of the upcoming T20 World Cup in October-November 2021.
